title: Massing Studio: A browser-based plan drawing and extrusion tool
description:
Massing Studio is a lightweight, browser-based tool for architecture students to sketch 2D plans and extrude them into 3D massing models, built to go from a plan diagram to an exportable 3D volume in minutes without the learning curve of a full CAD/BIM suite.

Shapes are drawn on a snap-grid 2D plan, then extruded by setting a height or dragging a Push/Pull tool directly in the 3D view — independently on a rectangle's four walls, an arbitrary polygon's edge, or a circle's radius. Floors stack as levels, with orthographic front, back and side elevations. Curves, dimension and area measurement, Intersect/Union/Subtract between volumes, and per-shape colour and transparency support early massing studies. Models import and export as .obj, .stl and .dxf for use in Rhino, Blender, SketchUp, a slicer, or another CAD package; a saved .obj reopens as an editable model, and the 3D view exports as a high-resolution PNG or JPEG on a transparent or white background. The method notes in docs/method-notes.html document every convention the tool relies on, name every source the code implements, and declare the tool's limitations.
